name: A2A Peptides
description: A2A Peptides is the cleared-commerce hub for the peptide industry, operated by GreenCore Solutions Corp. (GSC). It is a jurisdiction-and-pathway gate that only exposes items cleared to transact, with a catalogue behind it that only holds what passed. Every answer comes from a register page, carries its source and its rule-set version, and is signed. Agents reach it over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A); settlement is x402 after the gate. Research-use stock is a reject class the door names and refuses. No research and development happens here.

credential.description: an agent that transacts presents a credential issued to a licensed party; none returns DENY_UNLICENSED_AGENT

x402.description: registry-truth tools metered and order intents settled in USDC on Base; receipts signed with reason_code and rule_set_version

supportedInterfaces.description: MCP door — server a2a-peptides, twenty tools at v1.0
the page, its Markdown twin and the kit

skills.name: resolve jurisdiction
skills.description: Resolve the ship-to and the actor's jurisdiction to one of US, CA, MX, EU (member as parameter) or GB.

skills.name: resolve actor
skills.description: Resolve the actor class: patient, prescriber, pharmacy or 503B, wholesaler, cosmetic brand, retailer, or agent (an agent must present a credential).

skills.name: gate transaction
skills.description: Return allow, deny or require_rx for a substance or presentation, actor class, channel and ship-to, with the reason code and the rule-set version.

skills.name: get substance record
skills.description: One molecule: identifiers, sourced aliases, class, pathway rows per jurisdiction, enforcement events, safety references.

skills.name: get pathway status
skills.description: The status of a substance on one pathway in one jurisdiction, with effective date, rule-set version and source page.

skills.name: get compounding eligibility
skills.description: Whether a substance may be lawfully compounded in a jurisdiction, and under which list or standard.

skills.name: get label and indication
skills.description: Label and indication for a licensed presentation only.

skills.name: get enforcement watch
skills.description: Dated enforcement events: warning letters, import alerts, shortage-list changes, committee votes, seizures, state notices.

skills.name: search cleared items
skills.description: Search presentations that passed the gate for a jurisdiction, pathway and actor class.

skills.name: get item
skills.description: One authorised presentation: brand, strength, form, route, device, pack, holder, status, offers.

skills.name: compare presentations
skills.description: Compare two or more authorised presentations side by side.

skills.name: find licensed supplier
skills.description: Licensed parties for a presentation in a jurisdiction; tenant as a parameter.

skills.name: get availability
skills.description: Availability of a presentation from a licensed party, after the gate.

skills.name: get price
skills.description: Price basis (list, contract or reimbursement) from a licensed party, after the gate.

skills.name: get lot coa
skills.description: Certificate of analysis for a lawful lot where the pathway permits.

skills.name: verify serialization
skills.description: Verify a serialised pack against the serialisation regime of the jurisdiction.

skills.name: create order intent
skills.description: Create an order intent for a cleared item; the intent carries the reason code and the rule-set version, and settles by x402.

skills.name: a2a handoff
skills.description: Hand the order intent to the licensed counterparty's agent over Agent-to-Agent (A2A).

skills.name: get safety label
skills.description: Safety label pointers for licensed products.

skills.name: log audit
skills.description: Write the audit line for a gate decision or an order intent.

refusals.description: research-use stock is a reject class; no commerce tool touches it
an agent without a credential issued to a licensed party
the substance has no cleared pathway in the jurisdiction
a state or provincial overlay tightens the federal pass
a controlled substance in the jurisdiction
the ship-to is outside the licensed party's jurisdiction
